project_type.description: runtime-host is a deployed application; platform-package is a consumed library; docs-archive has no runtime; framework is supporting tooling without a client substrate.

profile.description: Adoption profile. tier1 provides deterministic gates and evidence; tier2 adds specification and sensor contracts; tier3 adds the complete human-supervised workflow. When absent, the strict tier3 posture applies.

adopted_at.description: When the repo first adopted DEVAI.

devai_version.description: Machine-managed package version stamped during initialization. `devai doctor` compares it with the installed @aarusso-nyx/devai version.

constitution.description: Constitution binding pin for the vendored `.devai/pin/constitution.md` copy. `devai doctor` verifies the digest; `devai init bind --constitution --write` refreshes the copy and pin.

version.description: The constitution version the repo is bound to, parsed from the vendored copy's version header.

sha256.description: sha256 of the vendored constitution text. Makes the pin load-bearing: doctor fails the binding check when the pin and the vendored copy disagree.

invariant_filters.description: Per-type rule filtering. Invariants whose `project_types` array (when present) excludes this project_type are skipped by validators.

feature_flags.description: Per-repo toggles for opt-in DEVAI features.

mode.description: cli-only covers DEVAI runtime actions; host-integrated additionally declares external-tool enforcement.

adapter_config.description: Repo-relative host adapter configuration, required for host-integrated mode.

kind.description: library: package consumed by other projects (MUST use docusaurus). application: business app running production traffic.

docs.description: Documentation build and publish configuration documented in docs/adopters/docs-layout.md.

builder.description: Documentation builder. Library repositories must use Docusaurus; see docs/adopters/docs-layout.md#repository-classification-and-builder.

build_command.description: Command to build the docs site. Defaults per builder if absent.

output_dir.description: Relative path from repo root to the build output directory.

publish_target.description: Reviewed documentation publication target. Publication remains a separately authorized external effect.

gh_pages_branch.description: Exact branch inspected by documentation governance when publish_target is gh-pages.

custom_domain.description: Custom domain for the published docs site. null or empty string means no custom domain (no CNAME file written).

collapsed_sections.description: Sections an application-tier adopter with no downstream consumers collapses to a single stub page pointing upstream instead of authoring in full; see docs/adopters/docs-layout.md#information-architecture.

path_overrides.description: D-125: maps a canonical F1/reading-order key (a docs/-rooted path with the docs/ prefix stripped, e.g. "framework/contracts") to the adopter's actual current relative path (e.g. "reference/contracts") when a binding ADR has relocated that substrate. Consulted by `devai doctor`'s f1-paths-present and agents-claude-sync checks before they test path existence / reading-order substring match. Absent key, or absent docs.ia entirely, leaves both checks byte-identical to pre-D-125 behavior.

ci_economy.description: CI-economy configuration documented in docs/adopters/ci-economy.md and amended by D-116.

profile.description: Enforcement profile for `devai check --only ci-economy`. full makes every rule binding. gate-staged keeps the evidence-gate rule visible but advisory while the other rules remain binding.

local_evidence.description: Local-CI-evidence policy (D-117; see docs/adopters/ci-economy.md). Declares what a local-evidence manifest must prove for `devai evidence local verify` to let the remote gate skip heavy tiers. Absent means the repo does not accept local evidence and the gate's fallback path runs heavy tiers remotely.

manifest_path.description: Committed manifest location. Default: .ci/evidence/local-ci.json (matches pre-promotion consumers; zero migration).

max_age_hours.description: Maximum manifest age accepted by verification. Default 24.

required_jobs.description: Local job names that must all be present with result=success in the manifest.

allowed_platforms.description: Platforms local jobs may run on. Default: linux/arm64, linux/amd64.

forbidden_paths.description: Path prefixes whose changes reject evidence mode (policy-sensitive surfaces). Merged with the built-in defaults (.github/workflows/, .devai/config/, the manifest's own directory); entries here extend, never replace.

require_docker.description: When true, verification requires observed docker version evidence in the manifest. Default false (not every adopter's local CI is containerized).

attested_rc.description: Trusted local RC evidence policy. When present, local-only nodes execute under Inspector authority and GitHub verifies the protected-tag attestation without executing candidate product commands.
